name: saas-mirror
description: Local replication of SaaS data for embedding/search

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core && tsc -b adapters/linear && tsc -b adapters/slack && tsc -b adapters/gmail && tsc -b adapters/notion && tsc -b adapters/gog
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p adapters/linear && tsc --noEmit -p adapters/slack && tsc --noEmit -p adapters/gmail && tsc --noEmit -p adapters/notion && tsc --noEmit -p adapters/gog
